notes.title: Update-Info Industry Transporters v0.7.802
notes.notes:
Additions: 
 
Added a lot of new town buildings (every level got 2 new variations, 13 new models)
Added a 2 new special town buildings like "cinema and amusement park"
Filled all Production Categories (added about 60 - 70 new products)
 

 Changes: 
 
Balance Changes:
[olist] 
rebalanced all sale prices
rebalanced also demand of all products
Adjusted the season bonus for all products (changed -,+ 35% to 15%)
[/olist]
Town growth after 2050 changed (discards any requirements for large buildings)
changed out terrain details to more grass and plants
Updated some old special town building models
able to disable/enable Joystick Input in options


 Fixes: 
 
Some UI fixes:
[olist] 
Fixed issue with town population info stuck in town hall unable to read it
Fixed a few checkboxes in option window which were not working
[/olist]
A lot of issue and error fixes:
[olist] 
Fixed an issue being unable to open vehicle window via click on vehicle
Fixed an error in the Steam Achievements
Fixed an issue with local stats
Fix for an issue when selling a vehicle other then trucks
Fix for error when loading rarely the cargo for trucks
Fixed an error in setting the traffic lights that could occur
Some fixes for issues with Player AI code
Fixed also an issue when upgrading a vehicle
Fixed another error that could rarely occur when loading a savegame
Some other smaller fixes
[/olist]

notes.title: Update-Info Industry Transporters v0.7.750
notes.notes:
Build 0.7.750

 Additions: 
 
Added 9 new Planes (nearly 80 in game) 
Added a few new cars like police/taxi and buses (10+ different traffic cars) 
Added first version of showing graphically traffic light states
 

 Changes: 
 
Tutorial Update:
[olist] 
videos to first few parts added
videos are available in main menu or when doing one of the tutorials (when a video is available for that part) 
[/olist] 
Added more effects to vehicles:
[olist] 
Ships got now a better water effect
Planes got smoke/afterburner effect and trail effect
Electric and Mono trains have small spark effects
[/olist]
ESC and Right mouse button allows player now to stop most modes like building
A few more optimizations on some models and textures
lowered performance needs for traffic lights (also changes bit slower, 5sec before now 8 sec timer)
Done a few adjustments to the options window (no more drop-down menus)
Infos of vehicles/buildings pop up faster


 Fixes: 
 
Fixed quite a few issues with trains
[olist] 
Fixed some pathfinding issues
Fixed some signal detection issues
[/olist]
Fixed a bunch of errors
[olist] 
Fixed a loading error that could stop loading a savegame rarely
Fixed a rare error that could occur while creating a random map
Fixed some other smaller errors in the game
[/olist]
Fixed missing info pics for all new vehicles and updated existing ones
Added some error messages like "no Steam running" or "Out of Memory"
Fixed a few tooltips
Fixed showing info window while building and upgrading (could get in the way in the background)
Fixed some detection issues for vehicles detecting not always trailers of trucks
Fixed a few other smaller issues

notes.title: Info to Update Industry Transporters v0.7.700
notes.notes:
Build 0.7.700

 Additions: 
 
Technology Settings (Editor) 
[olist] 
will help users to create their own missions by restricting the player of not being able to use buildings and vehicles
[/olist]
Event System (Editor, WIP) 
[olist]
allows players to create custom events that will be triggered when set requirements are met, also allows to control what will happen if the event is triggered
allows to set a message and name that will appear with the event
will help players also in creating their own missions
[/olist]
Event System (Game, WIP) 
[olist]
detects any set events and if requirements are met, will show event 	name + text as soon all requirements are met and trigger the set event
[/olist]


 Changes: 
 
Added the option to change between players neutral to player 8 (Editor)
Tutorial redone
[olist] 
Fixed outdated parts
Fixed some loading issues
Added more information to most part
Split Tutorial into smaller parts
[/olist]


 Fixes: 

Fixed a few issues with the path tool
[olist] 
Fixed an issue when building a street of size 2 unable to detect all connections
[/olist]
Fixed a lot of issues with actual stats
[olist] 
Fixed a few stats that were set properly
Split stats into multiple sections to get more detailed info
Fixed some issues with loading/saving the stats
[/olist]
Fixed some missing concrete floors
Fix for an issue with remade town street models (were having colliders and got vehicles stuck)
Fixed a few other smaller issues

notes.title: Information to Update Industry Transporters v0.7.660
notes.notes:
Build 0.7.660 
 Changes: 

Research Tree Changed:
[olist] 
Each Vehicle Tree is now unique with unique research skills
Added also first tree for industry/store upgrades
Shows way better actual state and progress via lines and background textures
Information about each Research is now a bit more detailed (requirements also listed / level shows actual and max one)
removed the tier system (made it too complicated)
research icons redone
 [/olist] 
Done a few changes to Worldmap:
[olist] 
Is now also fullscreen like research window
shows legend on the side
more accurate in finding the position
 [/olist] 
Prepared town street models for being able to show traffic lights (needed to lower the details a bit)
Redone all item pictures in a new frame and higher resolution
 

 Fixes:  

Player AI fixes:
[olist] 
Path finding for building streets reworked (is now able to move paths back when getting stuck to get a different path to go around buildings)
Uses now also new path tool to create more complete streets (were sometimes broken even when actually found a path)
Fixed a few issues in finding terminal position
Fixed an issue where the AI didn't checked range between industries and town (would sometimes create production over half the map)
Fixed a few errors that could occur while the AI was running
 [/olist] 
Truck issue fixes:
[olist] 
Fixed an issue where a truck could get into a loop due not reaching his goal with his detection system (increased detection range from 30 to 100)
Fixed also an issue where trucks would get stuck when moving in an end (the turnaround function was missing at that point in the code)
Fixed path finding over freeway parts (was still a bit wonky)
 [/olist] 
Fixed a few issues with registering and calculating repair costs
Fixed wrong localization for wheel menu
Fixed a few building issues when building freeway
Fixed a rotation issue with trucks and trains that could lead to reaching the wrong tile in a curve (now calculates the movement better)
lowered glow on all texts a bit to make it better readable
info window show timer will reset now every time mouse is moved (could be a pain when it opened even when moving mouse just because staying on same block)
Fixed a few other smaller issues

notes.title: Update Log for Industry Transporters v0.7.623
notes.notes:
Build 0.7.623 
 Additions: 

Added a new variation to each town building (6+ new models)
 

 Changes: 

Fixed popping of objects (will now cross-fade/ larger LoD ranges)
Random Generation creates now sometimes larger woods instead of multiple single 	trees
Optimization of FPS/Less Scrolling lags: 
[olist] 
rewrote part of object manager (loads now faster new buildings when scrolling)
town building models redone (lowered the amount of vertexes on a lot of town buildings and used material amount/ should now run faster over larger towns)
removed the nearly never used models of each build level for each town building (were rarely shown in the end and used up too much performance/ creates now construction models around the building being built while increasing in size with higher build level until finished) 
 [/olist]
 

 Fixes:  

Fixed an issue in the path-finding of trucks (there was still an issue when being unable to detect end goal in search range on first detection path and unable to find a definite answer, resulting in moving down the wrong path/ will now start a second search on the other path that might have the end goal in search-range)

notes.title: Update Log for Industry Transporters v0.7.620
notes.notes:
Build 0.7.620
 Changes: 

Balance changes: 
[olist]
Product: Wheels, now needs only 1x rubber instead of 2x (caused cars to use too much raw rubber for a single car)
Raw Rubber Production Increased by x1.35
[/olist]
Changed and re-enabled wheel menu: 
[olist]
added missing new buttons (more building categories and lists)
fixed a few issues
[/olist]
Demolishing tool mechanics changed: 
[olist]
is now selecting via holding left mouse button
releasing left mouse button will trigger now demolishing
pressing right mouse button while holding left mouse button will cancel demolishing
[/olist]
Deform tool mechanics optimized: 
[olist]
Deform point will now be controlled better (Will find now nearest point instead of always left down of mouse cursor)
New Area Flatten Mode (Right Mouse Button) = will now use cerulean colored point as for changing everything around it to the same level (often more expensive)
[/olist]
Done a few optimizations in the path building function (should cause less lags/faster building)
 

 Fixes:  

Fixed an issue where the loading system tried to load a wrong slot when there are some free slots between saved games
Fixed some issues where the space of a terminal could be filled due vehicles not unregistering themselves (will do now extra check when full, if it is really still filled)
Fixed a few errors that could occur when changing material on objects
Fixed an issue with positioning "Air Terminal (Normal)"
Fixed an issue where it was impossible to build electric or mono rail terminals
Fixed an issue where the details were not added when removing a building
Fixed also an issue in turning vehicles on a hill street (could lead to vehicles below map, stopped turning there for the time being)
Fixed a few path building issues as it would sometimes create normal street instead 	of an hill one
Fixed a few issues in research window: 
[olist]
Fixed missing tooltip
Fixed research icons not showing state "unable to research"
[/olist]
Fixed also a few issues with trains: 
[olist]
Fixed an issue where turning around function was bugged
Fixed a few more issues with setting position of trailers (would set them next to train on some models)
[/olist]
Fixed a few StackOverflowExeptions: 
[olist]
Fixed Error when removing all used marker points
Fixed Error when closing new building menu
[/olist]
Fixed quite a few UI issues: 
[olist]
Building Menu would sometimes close when changing just left panel buttons (was not needed for some buttons to close)
Left Panel building menu was not unsetting buttons when changing between industry and store
Windows could still be opened when using a mouse mode
[/olist]
Fixed a lot of issues with bridges and tunnels: 
[olist]
Fixed an issue when moving over a bridge or in a tunnel setting move speed to 0 of a vehicle/train
It was possible to modify terrain on a bridge/tunnel starting point
Fixed a few issues removing them (would leave some data back which was detected when building another bridge/tunnel over the same area)
[/olist]
